build: v137 Backend PR Review Gate Matrix
reviewKpis: How ready the first backend PR is for reviewer-specific approve, hold, block, and merge gates.
Named product, platform, backend, security, data, and release review lanes.
Evidence files the PR body should link before formal approval.
Unsafe conditions that prevent review or merge.
reviewerGateMatrix: Product owner
Approve alpha scope
Approve when alpha scope is explicit, the PR does not launch production SaaS, and no live customer data is accepted.
Hold when evidence links are placeholders or issue URLs are not opened.
Block if production launch, live data, or commercial scope creep appears.
green
Platform owner
Repo and branch rules
Approve when private visibility, branch naming, workflow names, and protection timing are proven.
Hold when workflow names, branch proof, or repo visibility evidence is missing.
Block if the repo is public, main is directly pushed, or required checks are guessed.
teal
Backend lead
Starter shell
Approve when root files, API shell, scripts, route boundaries, and first PR quality are clear.
Hold when install, lint, test, file tree, or ownership output is missing.
Block if backend files are unowned, unsafe, or outside the first PR scope.
blue
Security owner
No leak proof
Approve when no-secret, tenant guardrail, commercial redaction, and denial proof are visible.
Hold when scans, redaction proof, or audit evidence are missing.
Block if secrets, customer workbook data, certificates, live keys, invoices, or commercial values appear.
red
Data owner
Fixture boundary
Approve when generated fixtures, migration rollback, no workbook import, and source trace are clear.
Hold when seed, migration, rollback, or source-trace proof is incomplete.
Block if live workbook data or customer exports enter the repo.
amber
QA owner
Evidence closeout
Approve when screenshots, transcripts, issue links, PR proof, and go/hold/no-go notes are complete.
Hold when any proof file, screenshot, transcript, or closeout note is missing.
Block if merge readiness is claimed without full closeout evidence.
green
decisionGates: The PR stays draft while repo URL, issue URLs, command outputs, workflow names, or owner signoffs are missing.
The PR can request review after scope, proof links, rollback, blockers, and reviewer lanes are visible.
A reviewer can hold when a proof file, screenshot, transcript, check name, or owner answer is incomplete.
A reviewer must block if public repo, secret, workbook, commercial leak, direct main push, or no rollback appears.
A reviewer can approve only their lane after evidence and issue trace match the PR body.
Merge only after approvals, exact checks, no-leak proof, branch rules, closeout, and next owner are recorded.

Reviewer confirms private visibility, repo URL, owner, timestamp, and public-demo separation.
Reviewer confirms no secrets, workbooks, certificates, invoices, commercial exports, or live keys.
Reviewer confirms folder tree, copied starter files, approved omissions, and branch name.
Reviewer confirms issue URLs, labels, milestones, owners, and opening order.
Reviewer confirms PR link, title, scope, commands, risk reference, rollback note, reviewers, and blockers.
Reviewer confirms exact workflow names, job names, required checks, artifacts, and failed check notes.
Reviewer confirms required checks, review policy, conversation resolution, bypass decision, and screenshot reference.
Reviewer confirms passed, deferred, blocked, owner signoffs, next action, and packet handoff.
Reviewer checks whether GitHub account, git version, node version, npm version, and local path are captured.
Reviewer checks whether private visibility, repo URL, owner, and timestamp are written before file copy.
Reviewer checks whether no source workbook, secret, certificate, invoice, billing key, or commercial export is present.
Reviewer checks whether root, apps, packages, infra, docs, workflows, scripts, and evidence folders are visible.
Reviewer checks labels, milestones, issue waves, owner lanes, and generated URLs.
Reviewer checks PR title, URL, scope, proof links, rollback text, reviewers, and blockers.
Reviewer checks exact workflow, job, required check names, failed check notes, and artifact links.
Reviewer checks passed, deferred, blocked, no-leak proof, owner signoffs, rollback status, and next owner.
holdQueue: Private repo URL and visibility proof must be pasted before review starts.
Generated issue links must replace placeholders in the first PR body.
Placeholder evidence is allowed in draft, but must be explicit before review.
Required check names cannot be guessed before the first Actions run.
Each lane needs go, hold, no-go, or defer with reason.
Close PR, delete branch, recreate repo, rotate credential, or restart data path must be named.
Preflight, setup, quality, issue, PR, and closeout transcripts need output or blocker notes.
Passed, deferred, blocked, no-leak, owners, and next owner must be written.
blockRules: No production backend work can proceed in a public repo.
Any secret, token, certificate, or live key requires removal and rotation review.
Live Excel source data cannot enter the production backend repo.
Value, LOA, agreement, invoice, billing, and negotiation facts stay out of frontline examples.
A first backend PR must be safely closable without production effects.
All production backend work must stay on reviewable branches.
Workflow and job names must be exact before branch protection or merge trust.
Reviewer lane, next owner, and closeout owner must be named.
mergeReadinessChecklist: PR remains draft until proof exists
A draft PR can carry placeholders; a review-ready PR must link real proof or explicit holds.
Visibility screenshot and repo URL are recorded.
No secrets, workbooks, certificates, live keys, invoices, or commercial exports are present.
Issue URLs replace placeholders and map to generated issue lanes.
Evidence links point to files, screenshots, transcripts, or deferred blockers.
Each lane has approve, hold, block, and next action rules.
Required check names come from an actual Actions run, not guesses.
Passed, deferred, blocked, no-leak, rollback, owners, and next owner are written.
prCommentTemplates: Approved for my lane. Evidence is linked, issue trace is visible, rollback is clear, and no-live-data/no-secret boundaries are preserved.
Holding approval until the listed evidence file, command output, screenshot, owner response, workflow name, or issue URL is completed.
Requesting changes because the PR contains a trust blocker: public visibility, secret, workbook, commercial leak, no rollback, missing owner, or unsafe branch posture.
Merge is allowed only after all reviewer lanes are green, required checks are exact, branch protection is documented, and closeout names the next owner.
I confirm no customer workbook, production secret, certificate, payment key, invoice, billing export, or commercial tracker value is approved in this PR.
Deferred proof is acceptable only if the blocker file names the missing proof, owner, date, and next command.
